title: Tell us what's wrong
body: A person answers, asks four questions, and gives you an arrival window you can plan around.

title: See the price first
body: The plumber looks, then shows you the flat price from our price book. Nothing starts until you say yes.

title: Fixed, then tested
body: Drop cloths down, shoes covered, the repair tested under pressure, and the mess leaves with us.

title: Guaranteed
body: If our repair fails within twelve months, we come back and fix it again at no charge.
